task: Implement the data export feature that writes user records to S3. Token budget is tight due to large prior context.

candidate_memories.content: User records written to S3 must be encrypted at rest using SSE-KMS with the key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/user-data-key. Unencrypted writes to S3 are rejected by the bucket policy and will raise a security incident.
S3 bucket for user exports is s3://user-exports-prod; use multipart upload for files over 100 MB.
Export jobs must write a manifest file alongside the data file listing record count and checksum.
Export job is expected to produce ~2 GB per run; scheduled to run nightly at 02:00 UTC.
